cases.description: The AI opens a case when it needs a teammate to do something (grant access, check a payment) and keeps talking to the customer. If it promises the team will check without opening one, the system opens it.

voice.title: Answer voice notes with voice
voice.description: When a customer sends a voice note, the AI answers with a voice message (long replies stay as text). Uses the same OpenAI key as transcription and costs more than text.
voice.mirror: Answer in voice when the customer sends audio

transcription.title: Model that transcribes voice notes
transcription.description: When a customer sends a voice note, this model turns it into text for the AI to answer. It uses the knowledge-base OpenAI key; without one, voice notes are not understood.

keywords.title: Phrases that call a person
keywords.description: If the customer writes one of these, the conversation goes to a person immediately — no AI call, no tokens.
